newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly lower on Monday, pressured by sporadic selling in reaction to the yen's sharp gains against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.8 yen per kg lower. Benchmark October was off 0.3 yen at 139.3 yen.
Activity remained lacklustre. The market started lower on seeing the dollar slipping below 118 yen in early Tokyo trade.
"Selling emerged from the outset, but trading volume ebbed as market players would like to know whether the dollar will continue to slip against the yen," one trader said.
